description: This file is a shell script that provides utility functions for managing prplMesh services, including starting, stopping, restarting processes, handling logs, and modifying configuration parameters.

methods.name: send_signal_to_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Sends a specified signal to a prplMesh process by name.

methods.name: start_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Starts a prplMesh process by name.

methods.name: stop_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Stops a prplMesh process by name, with a timeout before sending KILL signal.

methods.name: roll_logs_function
methods.description: Handles log rotation for the prplMesh logs, sends USR1 signals to trigger log roll.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: odl_get_str_param
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value from associated ODL files.

methods.name: odl_set_param
methods.description: Sets a parameter value in associated ODL files, supporting string and boolean types.

methods.name: ensure_platform_db
methods.description: Ensures the presence of the platform database file, copying it if missing.

methods.name: certification_mode_to_num
methods.description: Converts various certification mode inputs to numeric representation (0 or 1).

methods.name: set_management_and_certification_mode
methods.description: Configures management and certification modes for prplMesh, updating configuration files accordingly.

methods.name: start_func
methods.description: Starts the prplMesh services based on current configuration and mode.

methods.name: stop_func
methods.description: Stops all running prplMesh services gracefully.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point handling command-line arguments to control the prplMesh services.
